verdict.rationale: Persona documents Selfie Verification that confirms a live individual is present, often paired with Government ID Verification, and general identity verification includes 'liveness checks' (persona-docs-12, 16, 24, 45). However, no evidence details specific documented defenses against printed photos, screen replays, or video replay attacks. Missing for 10: explicit anti-spoofing/liveness defense documentation (printed photo detection, screen detection, video replay detection), and any independent/hands-on validation of liveness robustness.
